map.先看日志——多半是主进程报错或执行完就结束（Docker 要求前台进程常驻）。若: Check the logs first — usually the main process errored out or finished immediately (Docker requires a long-running foreground process). If the logs are empty, use inspect to check the ExitCode and the start command; you can also override the entrypoint with docker run -it --entrypoint sh to get a shell inside the container and investigate by hand, then verify dependencies and configuration one by one.
